title: X Downloader & Video Player
summary: Download videos and images from any Websites & Social Apps fast and unlimitedly.
description:
🌟 Fast Video Downloader App. Save all videos and photos easily from the Internet.

XDownloader is a powerful tool that lets you download videos from any website or social media app, including TikTok (without the watermark), Facebook, Instagram, and more.

With XDownloader's built-in browser, you can seamlessly explore websites while the app automatically detects downloadable videos and images. Easily and securely download any content you choose. Once saved, enjoy offline playback anytime!

Key Features:
💎 Download videos from websites easily and fast.
💎 Download videos from IG, Twit, TT, FB and more
💎 Download TT videos without the watermark!
💎 Excellent web browsing experience!
💎 Supports several download formats (e.g., MP3, MP4, JPEG, PNG) and resolutions (480p, 720p, 1080p, and HD).
💎 Auto detect the videos you can download.
💎 Check the download progress in the download bar.
💎 Pause the download progress at any time.
💎 Fast download speeds!
💎 Movie downloader.
💎 Browser downloader.
💎 Supports background downloading with simultaneous multiple file downloads.
💎 Add bookmarks to important or favorite websites in the built-in browser.

Downloader for Videos and photos
This is an excellent downloader. It can download all videos and photos on the web. You can download and save whatever you want.

Seamless Social Media Video Downloader
You can download videos directly from social media, or simply share the video link for one-click downloads, all from your browser.

Browser Downloader
Easily detects and downloads videos directly from your browser. As you browse, the app automatically detects videos on the page, allowing you to download them with a single click.

HD Video Downloader
XDownloader supports downloading HD videos. With this video downloader, you can enjoy a good viewing experience.

Download Manager
XDownloader's download manager makes it simple to stop, restart, or end ongoing downloads. To handle your video downloads with ease, use the Download Manager!

Fast Video Downloader
Please try this fast video downloader, if you want a high downloading speed downloader. It is a high speed, easy-to-use downloader in the market. 

Safe and Fast Downloader
You can protect your videos with XDownloader. Files that have been downloaded can be kept in an encrypted vault that is only accessible by you.

💡  How to download from websites? 💡
① Visit the website with the built-in browser in XDownloader
② The videos and the images will be auto-detected, just tap the download button
③ Choose a video that you want to save
④ Done!

💡 How to download from social apps like IG or TT? 💡
① Open the social app and tap the share icon
② Tap Copy Link
③ Return to the XDownloader
④ Wait for the auto-detection and download
⑤ Video downloaded!
